Message.Name: Symbol Clear Message
Message.Description: The Symbol Clear message instructs feed recipients to clear all orders for the Cboe book in the specified symbol. This message will be sent at startup each day.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol right padded with spaces.

Message.Name: Add Order Message
Message.Description: An add order message represents a newly accepted visible order on the Cboe book. It includes a day-specific Order ID assigned by Cboe to the order.

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: Day-specific identifier assigned to this order.

Field.Name: Side Indicator
Field.Description: B = Buy S = Sell

Field.Name: Shares
Field.Description: Number of shares being added to the book (may be less than the number of shares entered).

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol, right added with spaces. Common Symbology Format.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Order price.

Field.Name: Display
Field.Description: Always "Y". Maintained for compatibility reasons.

Message.Name: Add Order Message Long Form
Message.Description: Only used on the Cboe European platform. As Add Order Message above, but with longer fields for Shares, Price and Symbol.

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: Day-specific identifier assigned to this order.

Field.Name: Side Indicator
Field.Description: B = Buy S = Sell

Field.Name: Shares
Field.Description: Number of shares being added to the book (may be less than the number of shares entered).

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol, right added with spaces. Common Symbology Format.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Order price (long format).

Field.Name: Display
Field.Description: Always "Y". Maintained for compatibility reasons.

Message.Name: Add Order Expanded
Message.Description: The Expanded Add Order is used on the Cboe Europe TRF platform to provide visibility of Systematic Internalizer quotes. (SI Quotes are not executable via the TRF platform.)

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: Day-specific identifier assigned to this order

Field.Name: Side Indicator
Field.Description: Valid values: B = Buy S = Sell

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Number of shares applicable to this quote.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol, right padded with spaces

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The quote price

Field.Name: Type
Field.Description: Attributed order type indicator. Currently defined values: S - 'SI' Quote

Field.Name: ParticipantID
Field.Description: Attributes this quote to a particular participant.

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: Order ID of a previously sent Add Order Message.

Field.Name: Executed Shares
Field.Description: Number of shares executed.

Field.Name: Execution ID
Field.Description: Cboe generated day-unique execution identifier of this execution. Execution ID is also reference in the Trade Break Message.

Field.Name: Execution Flags
Field.Description: Type flags based on MMT v3.04 standard

Message.Name: Order Executed Message Long Form
Message.Description: Only used on the Cboe European platform. As Order Executed Message above, but with a longer field for Executed Shares.

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: Order ID of a previously sent Add Order Message.

Field.Name: Executed Shares
Field.Description: Number of shares executed.

Field.Name: Execution ID
Field.Description: Cboe generated day-unique execution identifier of this execution. Execution ID is also reference in the Trade Break Message.

Field.Name: Execution Flags
Field.Description: Type flags based on MMT v3.04 standard

Message.Name: Order Cancel Message
Message.Description: Order Cancel Messages are sent when a visible order on the Cboe book is cancelled in whole or in part.

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: Order ID of a previously sent Add Order Message.

Field.Name: Cancelled Shares
Field.Description: Number of shares cancelled.

Message.Name: Order Cancel Message Long Form
Message.Description: Only used on the Cboe European platform. As Order Cancel Message above, but with a longer field for Cancelled Shares.

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: Order ID of a previously sent Add Order Message.

Field.Name: Cancelled Shares
Field.Description: Number of shares cancelled.

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: Obfuscated Order ID or Order ID of the invisible order or negotiated trade.

Field.Name: Side Indicator
Field.Description: Always "B".

Field.Name: Shares
Field.Description: Incremental number of shares executed.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol, right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Execution price of the fill.

Field.Name: Execution ID
Field.Description: Cboe generated day-unique execution identifier of this trade. Execution ID is also referenced in the Trade Break Message.

Field.Name: Trade Flags
Field.Description: Type flags based on MMT v3.04 standard

Message.Name: Trade Message Long Form
Message.Description: Only used on the Cboe European platform. As Trade Message above, but with longer fields for Shares and Price.

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: Obfuscated Order ID or Order ID of the invisible order or negotiated trade.

Field.Name: Side Indicator
Field.Description: Always "B".

Field.Name: Shares
Field.Description: Incremental number of shares executed.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol, right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Execution price (long format) of the fill.

Field.Name: Execution ID
Field.Description: Cboe generated day-unique execution identifier of this trade. Execution ID is also referenced in the Trade Break Message.

Field.Name: Trade Flags
Field.Description: Type flags based on MMT v3.04 standard

Message.Name: Trade Message Extended Form
Message.Description: Only used on the Cboe European platform. This provides extended details of trades reported to or executed by Cboe.

Field.Name: Shares
Field.Description: Number of shares executed.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol, right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Execution price of the fill. This may be zero if the price is pending, as denoted by Level 3.8 of the Extended Trade Flags.

Field.Name: Trade ID
Field.Description: Cboe generated identifier of this trade. This identifier is guaranteed to be unique for at least 7 calendar days.

Field.Name: Trade Date
Field.Description: Date on which the trade occurred, in the form YYYYMMDD.

Field.Name: Trade Time
Field.Description: Time at which the trade occurred, encoded as the number of milliseconds since midnight, on the day represented by Trade date, London time.

Field.Name: Execution Venue
Field.Description: The venue on which the trade executed, when applicable. This will contain the MIC representing the venue on which the trade occurred, where applicable. e.g. for Cboe NT trades, this shall be the segment MIC BATF for BXE off-book trades, CHIO for CXE off-book trades and BARO for REGM off-book trades. This will contain SINT if the trade occurred on a Systematic Internaliser or XOFF if OTC. Cboe LIS trades have the value LISX.

Field.Name: Currency
Field.Description: Traded currency.

Field.Name: Cboe Trade Timing Indicator
Field.Description: '1' The trade was reported to Cboe 'late', '2' The trade was reported to Cboe out of the Main Session, '3' The trade was reported to Cboe late and out of the Main Session, '-' otherwise.

Field.Name: Extended Trade Flags
Field.Description: Type flags based on the MMT v3.04 standard.

Message.Name: Trade Message Unknown Symbol
Message.Description: Only used on the Cboe European Trade Reporting Facility. This provides details of trades reported to Cboe, but traded on a symbol not currently known to Cboe.

Field.Name: Shares
Field.Description: Number of shares traded.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol in ISIN

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Reported price of the trade. This may be zero if the price is pending, as denoted by Level 3.8 of the Extended Trade Flags.

Field.Name: Trade ID
Field.Description: Cboe generated identifier of this trade. This identifier is guaranteed to be unique for at least 7 calendar days.

Field.Name: Trade Date
Field.Description: Date on which the trade occurred, in the form YYYYMMDD.

Field.Name: Trade Time
Field.Description: Time at which the trade occurred, encoded as the number of milliseconds since midnight, on the day represented by Trade date, London time.

Field.Name: Execution Venue
Field.Description: The venue on which the trade executed, when applicable. This will contain the MIC representing the venue on which the trade occurred, where applicable. The field will contain SINT if the trade occurred on a Systematic Internaliser or XOFF if OTC.

Field.Name: Currency
Field.Description: Reported currency.

Field.Name: Cboe Trade Timing Indicator
Field.Description: '1' The trade was reported to Cboe 'late', '2' The trade was reported to Cboe out of the Main Session, '3' The trade was reported to Cboe late and out of the Main Session, '-' otherwise.

Field.Name: Extended Trade Flags
Field.Description: Type flags based on the MMT v3.04 standard.

Message.Name: Trading Status Message
Message.Description: The Trading Status Message is used to indicate the current trading status of a security. A Trading Status Message will be sent whenever a security's trading status changes.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Status
Field.Description: "T" = Trading "R" = Off-Book Reporting "C" = Closed "S" = Suspended "N" = No Reference Price "V" = Volatility Interruption "O" = Opening Auction "E" = Closing Auction "H" = Halt "M" = Market Order Imbalance "P" = Price Monitoring Extension

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved

Message.Name: Statistics Message
Message.Description: Only used on the Cboe European platform. The Statistics Message is used to disseminate the statistics prices: opening, closing, high, low.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Price.

Field.Name: Statistic Type
Field.Description: "C" = Closing Price "H" = High Price "L" = Low Price "O" = Opening Price "P" = Previous Closing Price

Field.Name: Price Determination
Field.Description: "0" = Normal "1" = Manual (Price override by Market Supervision)

Message.Name: Auction Update Message
Message.Description: Auction Update messages are used to disseminate indicative price and size information during auctions for Cboe auction eligible securities. For Opening and Closing auctions, Auction Update messages are published periodically during the call and extension phases of the auction process.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Auction Type
Field.Description: "O" = Opening Auction "C" = Closing Auction "H" = Halt Auction "V" = Volatility Auction "P" = Periodic Auction

Field.Name: Reference Price
Field.Description: Reference price used in tie-breaker situations

Field.Name: Indicative Price
Field.Description: Price at which the auction would match if executed at the time of the message

Field.Name: Indicative Shares
Field.Description: Number of shares at the Indicative Price

Field.Name: Outside Tolerance
Field.Description: Indicates whether the price on this update is outside the Cboe EBBO collar: "O" = Outside tolerance "I" = Inside tolerance "-" = Not specified

Field.Name: Includes Primary
Field.Description: Indicates whether the Cboe EBBO used to collar this update includes the Primary Market quotes: "P" = Includes Primary "N" = Excludes Primary "-" = Not specified

Message.Name: Auction Summary Message
Message.Description: Auction Summary messages are used to disseminate the results of an auction in a Cboe auction eligible security.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Auction Type
Field.Description: "O" = Opening Auction "C" = Closing Auction "H" = Halt Auction "V" = Volatility Auction "P" = Periodic Auction

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Auction price

Field.Name: Shares
Field.Description: Cumulative number of shares executed during the auction
